name: Amsterdam Marathon
description: The Amsterdam Marathon is a flat and fast course through the beautiful city of Amsterdam, passing many famous landmarks like the Rijksmuseum, Vondelpark, and along the Amstel River.

cityInfo.transportInfo: Amsterdam has excellent public transport with metro, tram, and bus services. Consider purchasing a GVB day pass for easy travel between viewing spots. Bikes are also a great way to navigate the city on marathon day.

spectatorTips: Arrive at viewing spots 15-20 minutes before your runner is expected
Use public transport or bicycle between viewing locations
Consider using the city's bike-sharing service to navigate quickly
The area around the Olympic Stadium gets very crowded - arrive early
Bring an umbrella as Amsterdam weather can be unpredictable
Some good spots to see your runner multiple times: Vondelpark and Museumplein
